name: 20874 · Germantown, MD
findings: ZIP 20874 (Germantown) has 198 nonprofit organizations. 74 of them (37%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 62 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (27% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 20874 (Germantown) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.
